defs.def: to cover sth with ink so that it can be used for printing 给 … 上油墨（以供印刷）

ex.s: Although I have enjoyed breaking my decades-long taboo about working with oil paints, I have discovered I now prefer chalks and ink.
ex.t: 虽然我很享受打破几十年来不用油画颜料的禁忌，但我发现我现在更喜欢粉笔和墨水。

ex.s: Talk about works of art a b c These pictures are representative of ink wash animation films.
ex.t: 谈论艺术作品：这些图片代表水墨动画电影。

ex.s: From bronze bowls to ceramic vases, and jade sculptures to ink wash paintings, our goal is to display the Chinese artistic genius from ancient times.
ex.t: 从青铜碗到陶瓷花瓶，从玉雕到水墨画，我们的目标是展示中国古代的艺术天才。

ex.s: On the left and right side of the painting, Xu cleverly drew in black ink to show the moving hair on the horse's mane and tail.
ex.t: 在画的左右两侧，徐悲鸿巧妙地用墨汁绘制，展现了马鬃和马尾上飘动的毛发。

defs.def: to sign a document, especially a contract 签署，签订（合同等）

ex.s: Chinese characters are carved into small squares of stone and stamped onto paper with ink.
ex.t: 汉字被雕刻在小方石块上，用墨水印在纸上。

ex.s: Chinese artist Wu Guanzhong is 1_________(know) for his paintings using oils and also for those using the more traditional Chinese method of ink.
ex.t: 中国艺术家吴冠中以他的油画作品以及使用更传统的中国水墨方法的作品而闻名。
